variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.title: Gemini API key
variables.description: Used for page OCR when the provider is gemini (the default). Leave empty if you use OpenRouter.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.title: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: Only needed when the provider is openrouter. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: SCHOLAROCR_PROVIDER
variables.title: OCR provider
variables.description: gemini or openrouter. Leave empty for gemini.
